changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.delivery_channel (channel, active, security, last_updated) SELECT c.name, true, CASE WHEN c.name = 'EMAIL' THEN 'STARTTLS' ELSE NULL END, now() FROM (VALUES ('EMAIL'), ('SMS'), ('WHATSAPP')) AS c(name) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.delivery_channel d WHERE d.channel = c.name);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.delivery_channel WHERE channel IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS', 'WHATSAPP');

INSERT INTO clinlims.site_information_domain (id, name, description) SELECT nextval('clinlims.site_information_domain_seq'), 'delivery', 'Result delivery settings' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.site_information_domain WHERE name = 'delivery');
INSERT INTO clinlims.site_information (id, name, description, value, value_type, domain_id, lastupdated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.site_information_seq'), s.name, s.description, s.value, 'text', (SELECT id FROM clinlims.site_information_domain WHERE name = 'delivery'), now() FROM (VALUES ('delivery.retryDelays', 'Minutes between delivery attempts after a failure, in order', '1,5,15'), ('delivery.defaultFormat', 'Report format for recipients with no delivery password', 'MASKED'), ('delivery.holdMinutes', 'Minutes to wait before a new report version is sent', '10'), ('delivery.sendPartials', 'Send partial reports automatically', 'true'), ('delivery.labContact', 'Laboratory contact line used in messages', NULL), ('delivery.location', 'Where reports, alerts and notices are sent from: LOCAL or CENTRAL', 'LOCAL'), ('delivery.centralAddress', 'Address of the central delivery service', NULL), ('delivery.secureLinks', 'Carry secure links in report messages', 'false'), ('delivery.linkDays', 'Days a secure link stays open', '14'), ('delivery.countryCode', 'Default country code for phone numbers', NULL) ) AS s(name, description, value) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.site_information i WHERE i.name = s.name);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.site_information WHERE name LIKE 'delivery.%';

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_module (id, has_select, has_add, has_update, has_delete, system_role_id, system_module_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_role_module_seq'), 'Y', 'N', 'N', 'N', r.id, m.id FROM clinlims.system_role r CROSS JOIN clinlims.system_module m WHERE m.name = 'SentMessages' AND (r.name IN ('Reports', 'Global Administrator') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_module rm JOIN clinlims.system_module pm ON pm.id = rm.system_module_id WHERE pm.name = 'ReportPrintQueue' AND rm.system_role_id = r.id AND rm.has_select = 'Y')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_module x WHERE x.system_role_id = r.id AND x.system_module_id = m.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.system_role_module WHERE system_module_id = (SELECT id FROM clinlims.system_module WHERE name = 'SentMessages');

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.menu (id, parent_id, presentation_order, element_id, action_url, display_key, is_active) SELECT nextval('clinlims.menu_seq'), (SELECT id FROM clinlims.menu WHERE element_id = 'menu_reports_routine'), COALESCE((SELECT presentation_order FROM clinlims.menu WHERE element_id = 'menu_reports_printqueue'), 0) + 1, 'menu_reports_sentmessages', '/SentMessages', 'sidenav.label.reports.sentMessages', true WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.menu WHERE element_id = 'menu_reports_sentmessages') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.menu WHERE element_id = 'menu_reports_routine');
